title: Saudi Ministry of Education Chairs First Meeting of the Universal Access Committee
summary: The Saudi Ministry of Education chaired the first meeting of the Universal Access Committee, involving multiple sectors inside and outside the ministry, to advance accessibility standards within the education system.
body:
The Saudi Ministry of Education chaired the first meeting of the Universal Access Committee, involving multiple sectors inside and outside the ministry, to advance accessibility standards within the education system.

Read more from the original source: [news.google.com](https://www.moe.gov.sa/ar/mediacenter/MOEnews/Pages/A-25478.aspx)
